method.ratings_and_required_lists: Majority of the three families, except where the v3.3 rating rules or the GOLD_RUBRIC question rule force a different resolution; every such override is recorded per turn.
method.allowed_lists: Union of the three families, minus concepts that contradict the adjudicated rating or are unsupported by the case facts; every exclusion is recorded with a reason.
method.critical_invariants: Token retained when at least two of the three families listed it.
method.uncertainty: gold_uncertain is set only where the three families disagree categorically and the case text plus the v3.3 rules cannot resolve the disagreement.
v3_3_rules_applied: An established omission of a token that a named execution step depends on is Red, not Gray.
An occluded Data B token routes to Intake with null ratings.
An occluded Data A token beside an identifiable sendable draft stays in Normal mode and Grays the affected dimension.
preserve-intended-recipient is never a required revision concept.
